definition: Regulation of consciousness is the brain’s control of conscious state, including maintaining awareness and alertness. In the source, this function is described as one of the roles of the thalami.

reasons: The definition states that regulation of consciousness is the brain’s control of conscious state, including maintaining awareness and alertness. While the packet does support that thalami are involved in “regulation of consciousness” and “alertness,” it does not directly support the rest of the wording in the first sentence beyond those limited functions.
